title.narrative: Improving Connectivity and Urban Infrastructure in Cabo Verde

description.narrative: The higher-level objective of the Project—to improve access to climate resilient transport and urban infrastructure for selected project areas in the Recipient's territory—remains unchanged under the Additional Financing (AF). Through this AF, the Project will deepen and scale up its support to both urban and rural communities.The Project continues to enhance the quality of life in targeted urban neighborhoods through integrated urban upgrading, including drainage, public spaces, slope stabilization, and improvements to basic urban services. In rural and peri urban areas, the Project will further reduce isolation by rehabilitating and upgrading critical road corridors, strengthening year round access and resilience to extreme weather events. The AF also incorporates targeted investments supporting post disaster recovery needs following the 2025 floods.The AF will focus on four of the five components of the parent project:1. Component 1: Resilient Urban and Community InfrastructureScales up urban upgrading interventions, including the remaining priority investments and selected post disaster recovery works, with a focus on climate resilient designs and community-level benefits.2. Component 2: Enhancing Transport Connectivity and ResilienceExpands the portfolio of road rehabilitation projects to improve connectivity, strengthen resilience to climate risks, and support safer mobility in selected roads.3. Component 3: Technical AssistanceProvides analytical work, capacity-building, and sectoral support—including road safety and inter-island connectivity. 4. Component 4: Project Management and Capacity BuildingSupports the effective implementation of the project by strengthening institutional capacity, monitoring, environmental and social management, procurement, and overall coordination—including a cohort based E&S trainee program.
To support improved access to climate-resilient transport and urban infrastructure for selected communities in Cabo Verde.
